name: Web Application Reconnaissance — High Volume of 4xx Responses
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = apache_httpd_raw
| alter status = to_integer(xdm.network.http.response_code),
        uri = xdm.network.http.url,
        ua = xdm.source.user_agent,
        method = xdm.network.http.method
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null and status >= 400
| filter uri contains "/admin"
       or uri contains "/login"
       or uri contains "/wp-"
       or uri contains "/phpmyadmin"
       or uri contains "/.env"
       or uri contains "/.git"
       or uri contains "/config"
       or uri contains "/backup"
       or uri contains "/console"
       or uri contains "/.aws"
       or uri contains "/actuator"
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as recon_4xx,
       count_distinct(uri) as distinct_paths,
       values(uri) as scanned_paths,
       values(ua) as user_agents,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as tgt_ips
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter recon_4xx >= 30 and distinct_paths >= 10
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, tgt_ips, scanned_paths, user_agents
description: External IP scanning Apache for vulnerabilities — many 4xx errors.
alert_name: Web Application Reconnaissance — High Volume of 4xx Responses
alert_description:
What fired: External IP scanning Apache for vulnerabilities — many 4xx errors.

Why it matters: an actor is enumerating hosts, services, shares, or accounts to map the environment. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1595 - Active Scanning (TA0043 - Reconnaissance).

Investigate:
  - Identify the scanning source and the number/range of targets it touched.
  - Confirm the source is not an authorized scanner/vuln tool; look for follow-on access to any enumerated target.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
